messages:
eva-partnerships: Starting a quick thread for the marketplace IaC handoff. We need a minimal, repeatable artifact set to onboard an offer to AWS/GCP/Azure: EULA PDF, support URL, asset bundle (tar.gz), manifest.json, offer metadata (name, description, pricing plans), and billing SKU map. Who will own each item?

noah-cloudinfra: I can own the asset bundle pipeline and the manifest generator. Plan: an action that uploads assets to a cloud-agnostic staging bucket and emits `manifest.json` with checksums and S3/GCS/Azure paths.

sam-engineering: For Terraform, recommend a small module per cloud that consumes the manifest and variables: publisher_id, offer_alias, contact_email, support_url, pricing_csv. Keep secrets out of repo (use secret manager or pass at runtime).

rita-legal: I'll take EULA PDF and approved listing copy. Also need to vet any references to data residency or encryption. Note: Azure compliance flagged "managed keys" language previously; I'll provide a safe template.

eva-partnerships: Important: we also need to support both "Redwood-published" and "Customer-published" flows. For customer-published, include a one-page runbook on swapping publisher credentials and changing support contact.

noah-cloudinfra: Agreed. I'll add a `customer-flow.md` to the repo that spells out service principal creation (Azure), vendor registration (GCP), and IAM role requirements (AWS).

sam-engineering: Also: include a tiny preview script that validates manifest checksums and runs a dry-upload (no publish) so PMs can QA the bundle before we submit to marketplaces.

ops-bot: Created ticket #PLAT-9155: marketplace-iac-handoff. Assigned to noah-cloudinfra. Link: https://phab/redwood/TPLAT-9155

r-ita-legal: (typo) Rita here, will post EULA template by Wednesday.

eva-partnerships: Nice catch. Follow-ups: noah to scaffold repo with modules + sample manifest by end of week; sam to add Terraform examples; rita to drop legal artifacts; I'll coordinate customer-facing docs. Sync Friday 11am PT?

noah-cloudinfra: Yep, I'll open the repo and include an examples/ directory with mock assets and a sample `manifest.json` schema.

sam-engineering: I'll include a `variables.tf` snippet in README demonstrating the minimal inputs. Example: ```terraform
module "marketplace_offer" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac.git//modules/aws"
  publisher_id = var.publisher_id
  manifest_path = var.manifest_path
  support_email = var.support_email
}
```

eva-partnerships: Thanks everyone. If you hit blockers ping #partnerships-ops and tag me. Closing thread for now. :rocket:
